metaDescription: A local-first companion for browsing Kill Team rules, building legal teams and taking the codex to the table.

hero.title: Kill Teams. One codex.
hero.description: Browse rules, build legal rosters and carry every operative in one focused mobile companion.

stores.appStoreLabel: KTCodex for iPhone on the App Store
stores.playStoreLabel: KTCodex for Android on Google Play

story.title: From source material to battle-ready data.
story.description: KTCodex turns dense rules into a system that is faster to scan while a game is moving.

chapters.title: Build within the rules
chapters.body: The selection flow resolves operative limits, loadouts and team composition before the roster reaches the table.

chapters.title: Read at game speed
chapters.body: Weapons, abilities and special rules stay together, with the details that matter arranged for quick scanning.

chapters.title: Keep the field offline
chapters.body: Snapshots, collections and preferences live locally, so the reference remains useful without a reliable connection.

system.title: A data product disguised as a field manual.
system.body: The interface sits on a versioned, localized rules pipeline. New source material can arrive without turning every screen into a special case.

features.title: Structured rules
features.body: Canonical schemas separate game meaning from presentation.

features.title: Localized by design
features.body: Eight languages share the same versioned content model.

features.title: Made for real matches
features.body: Readable hierarchy and resilient offline data reduce table friction.

closing.title: Take the codex with you.
closing.body: Store releases are being prepared. The product page is ready for the moment they go live.
